description: Prepare -> execute for onchain agent actions: policy pre-flight, simulation, signer hand-off and a hash-chained receipt log. Package @satohub/kit@0.1.
rules: Run `npx -y @satohub/kit@0.1 mcp` for the stdio MCP server; keep the 0.1 pin.
Always prepare before execute; execute takes only { intent_id }.
The network is fork by default; mainnet needs an explicit policy opt-in.
The policy is a pre-flight that explains refusals; the signer enforces limits.
